text_7aba019c05af: The work report has three tabs: Duty time and passenger travel, Train journey and details (GPS), and Work reports for the month. Choose the relevant tab. They use the same design as the journey tabs. Switching tabs preserves your entries and keeps GPS recording running. Opening a report from the monthly list or creating a new one shows Duty time and passenger travel. A restored GPS recording opens Train journey and details (GPS). If a required entry is missing, validation opens the tab containing that field.
